sqlMap.select: SELECT F_SPLIT(TEXT1,'^',3) AS JCO_CLIENT, F_SPLIT(TEXT1,'^',2) AS JCO_LANG, F_SPLIT(TEXT1,'^',1) AS JCO_SYSNR, TEXT2 AS JCO_USER, TEXT3 AS JCO_PASSWD, TEXT4 AS JCO_ASHOST, TEXT5 AS JCO_R3NAME, TEXT6 AS JCO_GROUP FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'AEKY' AND VALUE1 = #server_mode# AND FLAG = 'Y'

select d01 as BUKRS , d02 as ZISSID , d03 as ZMKDT , d04 as HWAER , to_number(d05) as HWBAS , to_number(d06) as HWSTE , to_number(d07) as ZTTAT , d08 as ZORG_ID from kep_data where job_id = 'AEKY_AR_HD' order by seq

select d01 as BUKRS , d02 as ZISSID , d03 as MBLP , d04 as KOSTL , d05 as HKONT , to_number(d06) as HWBAS , to_number(d07) as HWSTE , to_number(d08) as ZTTAT from kep_data where job_id = 'AEKY_AR_DT' and d02 = '2022102011000008s0230050' order by seq
